subject: CAIQ: evidence delegation and runtime-log tokenization proof request
messages:
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@sunsetbank.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: audits@sunsetbank.com
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: CAIQ evidence: runtime logs & delegation of control owners

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. As part of our upcoming CSA assessment we need a focused CAIQ package for a subset of controls tied to runtime telemetry and key management. Two specific asks from our security assurance team:

1) A control-delegation manifest that lists the Redwood control owners for the CSA subcontrols in the RoT (runtime telemetry, log collection, KV store access, tokenization/PII redaction).

2) A short proof bundle that demonstrates runtime log tokenization in action (example: request IDs, anonymized tokens, and an audit trail that shows how KV cache artifacts are redacted).

We've attached a short request template (CAIQ_Request_SunsetBank_20271129.pdf) and a CSV with sample log IDs we'd like you to reference (runtime_log_sample_ids.csv). Our assessment window is the week of Dec 6 — can you confirm ownership and whether we can get the artifacts by Dec 3?

Appreciate it — Marta
Marta Lopez
Security Assurance Manager
Sunset Bank Solutions

----

Attachment: runtime_log_sample_ids.csv (csv, 2KB)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: CAIQ evidence: runtime logs & delegation of control owners

Marta — thanks for the template and sample IDs. We can produce a scoped CAIQ package for those runtime/telemetry subcontrols. Proposed plan:

- I will own coordination and sign off on timelines.
- Kimberly will provide the technical runtime traces and a redaction/tokenization play-by-play.
- Marissa will assemble the evidence binder (annotated artifacts + doc links) and upload to a shared folder.

Target delivery: artifacts uploaded by EOD Dec 2, which gives your team time before the Dec 6 window. If we need a DocuSign attestation for particular claims we can route that the same day.

Questions: do you need live log samples, or are redacted snapshots with timestamps sufficient for your auditors?

I'll start pulling owners together and will follow up with a checklist.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 14:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ evidence: runtime logs & delegation of control owners

Marta — quick technical note from the runtime team:

- We can provide redacted snapshots that preserve request_id, event_timestamp, service_name, and a deterministic token (SHA256 prefix) representing any PII. That deterministic token maps back to a secure keystore entry (KMS/HSM) and an audit event that shows key usage.
- For the CAIQ mapping, I've attached a small mapping table in the planned binder: which Redwood config (env, service, agent) implements each CSA subcontrol and who the control owner is.

Regarding live samples: we prefer to avoid streaming live production logs to external auditors. Standard practice is redacted snapshots plus a signed log-replay transcript that shows the replay was run within the stated audit window. If Sunset requires live tailing, we can discuss a VPC/partner connection and an escrowed viewer session.

I'll prepare the runtime trace examples and an implementation note (tokenization algorithm + keystore audit events).

— Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Principal PM, Security Integrations
Redwood Inference

Anticipating the Dec 2 delivery but will flag any blockers.

— Marissa

Thanks — I can confirm receipt of the Drive link and the initial artifacts. A few quick asks from the audit team after a first pass:

- Please include a simple mapping file that ties each runtime snapshot filename to the exact subcontrol ID in the CAIQ (helps our evidence reviewers).
- We need a DocuSign attestation for the control-owner_manifest.csv that the named owners accept responsibility for the control statements during the audit window (Dec 6–10).
- For the KMS events: could you add a short timeline that links the exported audit events to the sample request_ids we submitted?

If you can push the mapping file and the DocuSign envelope by EOD Dec 2 we'll be in good shape. If anything blocks that timeline, please escalate to Rishi.

Best,
Marta
